cover.title: 5 Muscle Growth Apps
cover.subtitle: Loggers track your lifts — but #3 tracks the muscle itself.

caption: I ranked 5 apps for tracking muscle gain 💪 Four are brilliant at logging your lifts — the inputs — but #3 is the only one that tracks the actual output: your muscle, scored across 12 groups from a single progress photo. Log your lifts in the others, then check the result in #3. GainFrame is free on iOS. #musclegain #gymtok #fitnessapps #bodybuilding #bodycomposition
